title: Extra Life
blurb: A quick three-note ascending jingle — the unmistakable shape of earning an extra life. Half a second of pure reward. Use it when someone gets a second chance they arguably didn't earn: a retake, a rematch, a relationship. Streamers use it for donation alerts; editors for comeback moments. Original 8-bit style synthesis, free to use anywhere.
origin: Original 1-up style jingle synthesis in the 8-bit tradition.
